title: Shard letters assemble, zoom, image drop
summary: Four bold one-word lines assemble from tilted letter shards on flat cream, hold, then a fast zoom pushes the outer lines off frame and a key-art still drops into the gap between the two middle words.
use_when: A release-date teaser for a show, drop or launch day
A 2-3 s silent feed loop that ends on one key image
Announcing what is coming and when, before showing it

look.type_style: heavy grotesk, all caps, tight tracking, centred; resolved lines about 7 % H, after the zoom about 11 % H

sfx.event: letter shards settle into the four lines
fast zoom pushes the outer lines off frame
key-art still drops into the gap

structure.shot: flat cream; four one-word caps lines (two top, two bottom, empty middle) assemble from tilted letter shards, hold, then zoom
structure.camera: static 0-38 fr, then push-in 1.00 -> 1.60 (word width 52 % -> 84 % W) over f38-f57, decelerating; centred on the empty middle
structure.motion: letters scatter assemble: shards appear f8 (±0.25 s), rotated up to ~10 deg, partly drawn, resolve upright by f30 (±0.25 s), springs.ui (overshoot not measurable); bottom lines lag top by ~4 fr (±0.25 s); zoom easings.outExpo 19 fr

structure.shot: same zoomed frame: one word top, one word bottom; a landscape key-art still sits in the gap, ~53 % W, centred
structure.motion: still appears on the cut frame f57 at full size, no entrance; everything holds to the end f72

params.lines: 4 one-word caps lines: top pair (maker or brand, title word), bottom pair (status word, day or date); top-1 and bottom-2 leave frame in the zoom
params.image: one landscape key-art still, about 16:10, shown in the gap after the zoom
params.background: flat warm light colour, text near black

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheet (±0.25 s). Assembly f8-f30, hold f30-f38, zoom f38-f57 to 1.60x, cut f57, still holds 15 fr. The catalogue calls this a glyph scramble; the sheets show tilted, partly drawn letter shards resolving in place, not random characters cycling. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): shard-assemble, gap-drop. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Missing component: GapImage (image placed between zoomed words); a plain Img inside the Camera works.
